summary: The aws-c-cal 0.9.13 Conan recipe PR passes the strict audit. No P0 (deception), P1 (recipe correctness), or P2 (code style) issues were found. The test_package/test.c genuinely calls aws_cal_library_init() and aws_cal_library_clean_up() (R34 satisfied). The conandata.yml has a valid 64-hex sha256 and uses a single official GitHub URL. The conanfile.py uses settings.os in ('Linux', 'OHOS') (R32), has no shell environment variable usage (R33), and uses Conan 2.x API (R16). manifest.yaml status is 'built' (correct for no conan upload). No template placeholders, no local state files, no *.log files, and no pre-compiled binaries in the PR. PR is atomic — all 11 changed files are under archives/a/aws-c-cal/ (W2 satisfied). Five P3 suggestions are noted for future improvement but are non-blocking.

issues.description: The G0 section text is truncated mid-word: '无法匹配任何已知平台（Lin' appears cut off. This is a cosmetic issue in a generated report and does not affect recipe correctness.
issues.recommendation: Regenerate or fix the truncated text in the conan-verify-report.md G0 section for completeness.

issues.rule: code-style.md Rule 16 (import order) / general Python cleanliness
issues.description: The 'import os' statement is imported but only referenced in a commented-out line (the self.run(...) alternative). No actual code path uses 'os'. This would trigger flake8 F401 (unused import).
issues.recommendation: Remove the unused 'import os' from test_package/conanfile.py, or uncomment the alternative test execution line if intended as a fallback.

issues.description: The test uses extern forward declarations for aws_cal_library_init/aws_cal_library_clean_up instead of including the actual header (aws_cal.h). This is a documented workaround (notes.md: 'aws-c-common 和 aws-lc 的 conanfile.py 缺少 cpp_info.includedirs 声明'). The test genuinely calls the API (not a deception), but forward declarations bypass type checking and are less robust than including headers.
issues.recommendation: Once the dependency recipes (aws-c-common, aws-lc) are fixed to declare cpp_info.includedirs, update test.c to include <aws/cal/aws_cal.h> and use proper types instead of forward declarations.

issues.description: The package_info() method does not declare self.cpp_info.requires for aws-c-common and aws-lc. This means consumers must manually find_package() and link these transitive dependencies. The test_package CMakeLists.txt handles this correctly by explicitly finding and linking all three packages, but adding cpp_info.requires would make the recipe more robust for downstream consumers.
issues.recommendation: Add self.cpp_info.requires = ['aws-c-common::aws-c-common', 'aws-lc::aws-lc'] in package_info() so consumers automatically get transitive dependencies when linking aws-c-cal.

issues.rule: code-style.md Rule 11 (C/C++ test source naming convention)
issues.description: The project name and target name 'test_aws-c-cal' use hyphens. While valid in CMake 3.15+, underscores (test_aws_c_cal) are the more conventional naming style for CMake targets and projects.
issues.recommendation: Consider using underscores in the CMake project/target name for consistency with CMake naming conventions.

R34_empty_test.detail: test_package/test.c calls aws_cal_library_init() and aws_cal_library_clean_up() — real API calls, not printf-only stubs.

R9_skip_test.detail: test_package/conanfile.py test() method calls cmake.test() — proper ctest invocation. No 'pass', no commented-out test, no os.system('exit 0').

fake_status.detail: manifest.yaml (version): status=built. manifest.yaml (software): status=built. Correct — no conan upload performed, so 'built' not 'published'.

fake_sha256.detail: sha256='80b7c6087b0af461b4483e4c9483aea2e0dac5d9fb2289b057159ea6032409e1' — 64 hex chars, not all-zeros, not all-f, not 'REPLACE_WITH_ACTUAL_SHA256'.

R19_manual_packaging.detail: No .so/.a/.o/.bin files in the 11 changed files. All artifacts built from source via CMake.

R8_ohos_stub.detail: No #ifdef __OHOS__ guards in any changed file. Not applicable.

R40_deep_adaptation.detail: aws-c-cal is a crypto abstraction library, not in the R40 special categories (graphics/UI/multimedia/peripheral/system-level). Delegates to aws-lc for actual crypto. Not applicable.

R32_platform_compatibility.detail: conanfile.py uses 'if self.settings.os in ("Linux", "OHOS"):' — correct tuple form, not '== "Linux"'.

R33_no_shell_env_vars.detail: No os.environ usage in conanfile.py. Only os.path.join() used for path construction. No $DEFAULT_PREFIX or similar.

R37_version_number.detail: First adaptation, uses upstream version 0.9.13 (no suffix). Correct per R37.

conandata_sha256.detail: sha256 present, 64 hex chars, valid. Not a placeholder.

R39_official_source.detail: URL points to official GitHub awslabs/aws-c-cal repository. Not a personal fork or unknown CDN.

manifest_status_built.detail: Version manifest: status=built. Software manifest: status=built. Correct for no conan upload.

R16_conan2_api.detail: Uses 'from conan import ConanFile' and 'conan.tools.cmake'. No 'from conans' legacy imports.

R26_system_name_library.detail: aws-c-cal is not a system-name library (not zlib/openssl/libxml2/ncurses). Recipe defaults to static (shared=False) anyway. Not strictly applicable.

R6_no_generated_files.detail: No modifications to config.h, configure, Makefile.in, CMakeCache.txt, or other generated artifacts.

R38_commands_json.detail: aws-c-cal is a library (package_type='library'), no commands.json needed. Not applicable.

no_template_placeholders.detail: No '# CI fills this', no '<TODO:>', no 'REPLACE_WITH_ACTUAL_SHA256', no TODO/FIXME/XXX found in any file.

shebang_docstring.detail: Both conanfile.py files have #!/usr/bin/env python3 and docstrings with software name and build system.

package_type.detail: package_type = 'library' — correct for a library package.

method_order.detail: export_sources → requirements → layout → source → generate → build → package → package_info. Correct order per Rule 3.

no_placeholders.detail: No TODO/FIXME/XXX/pass # TODO in any file.

conandata_yml_format.detail: 2-space indent, quoted string values, HTTPS URL. Compliant with Rule 13.

import_order.detail: Standard library (os) → blank line → third-party (conan). Compliant with Rule 16.

test_source_rules.detail: File name lowercase (test.c), has main() returning int, calls real API. Compliant with Rule 11.

W2_atomicity.detail: All 11 changed files are under archives/a/aws-c-cal/. Single recipe PR only. No framework files mixed in.

no_log_files.detail: No *.log files in changed_files list. (conan-verify-report.md references a .log path but the log file itself is not in the PR.)

no_summary_md.detail: SUMMARY.md not in changed files. CI-maintained file not modified.

R21_permission_boundary.detail: No modifications to SKILL.md/references/templates/scripts/ci/index.tsv. All files within archives/ boundary.
